Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.classes

Class ClassAbilities

java.lang.Object
dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.classes.ClassAbilities
public final class ClassAbilities extends Object
The passive ability types of the built-in classes, as PlayerClass.getAbilityType() reports them.

Each built-in class runs one ability. Until 1.8.0 the API knew these by older names that described mechanics Zentrix no longer has; those names are still accepted in content/classes.yml and resolve, as aliases, to the ability the class really runs:

Ability types and their legacy aliases
ClassAbility typeLegacy alias
Warrior"TRUE_DAMAGE_PROC"KILL_REWARD
Archer"BOW_SHOT_BUFF"-
Looter"CHEST_BONUS"MOB_EXTRA_DROP
Trapper"FALL_DAMAGE_REDUCTION"WOOD_CONSERVATION
Fisherman"FISHING_BONUS"-
Miner"AUTO_SMELT"ORE_DOUBLE_DROP
Since:
1.8.0
